record: Rule-6 mutants for the polaris-dossier S8 slice (syzygy-qkea.9), fidelity review packets and review-check (REQ-polaris-generation-035, 006): the packet carrying the draft read account, omitting the spans the inventory cites, reading a span screening excludes, built from a draft with findings, from a frozen draft altered after its check or without an inventory of record, and carrying other lines than cited; a verdict bound to a stale packet, under the authoring or inventory session identifier, omitting an entry from coverage or accuracy or a claim block, naming a span the packet lacks, relying on a quotation that does not verify or quoting an excluded span, a quotation naming no span, a duplicated row, the shared reviewVerdict rule skipped, readiness beside a blocking row, and each blocking clause (unsupported entry, entry not accurate, unsupported block) removed; a refused verdict counting, a verdict counting after its frozen bytes change, after the draft or inventory is revised or altered, without a launch form, or under a launch record of another form or kind; the review session identifier, launch form, independence and inventory completeness shown or recorded as Observed or not disclosed as Inferred; a design packet or design session before render exists; the review session directory inside the run directory, its prompt without SEC-3, its directory without the packet digest; a finding without its deficient subject; and the declared readiness, the counted verdict or a reviewer finding shown or carried as Observed, or the reviewer reading of the packet not disclosed as Inferred. Not authority.
method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` (exactly one occurrence) in one file of the S8 worktree at `commit`, runs `command` from the worktree root, then restores the file; the tree was clean after the run. A mutant is killed only when the replacement applied and the command exits nonzero.
history: Before the first run, three readiness cases (an unsupported entry, an unsupported block, an entry not accurate), a ready verdict with no blocking row, an altered launch record, a duplicated row and an unnamed quotation were added as tests, because the blocking clauses, the launch-record binding and the duplicate and count rules were otherwise reached by no test; the commit was amended and a first run of M1-M40 killed 39. M6 (a packet built without an inventory of record) survived: the next line refused at the same stage when it read the missing file, and the test asserted only the stage. The refusal tests now assert each reason. Following the lead (2026-10-07), the packet labels the inventory coverage self-report Inferred (M41), and a test sweeps every key at every depth of the packet for discovery, transcript and exchange fields, with its own planted-field mutant. Following the lead again (2026-10-07: the reviewer reading of the emitted packet is never Observed), the readiness a check records and the verdict a counted review carries are labelled Inferred and declared by the review session, the Inferred basis opens with the reader reading, and the Observed sweep widened to the review-packet report, the stored check record, both CLI JSON outputs and the packet, asserting that an Observed value holds exactly the packet digest and whether the verdict names it and no verdict key or reviewer-written string (M42-M46). An earlier record of 41 of 41 at the previous amend of this commit was withdrawn before it reached a pull request. The commit was amended again and all 46 re-run at `commit`.
